capabilities: Embed websites as Gate panels on the left, center, or right of the UI
Inject custom CSS to restyle embedded sites
Link to Gates from within notes
extras: Support is handled through an external support portal and Discord; a detailed tutorial is hosted outside the README. Claims to embed sites that cannot be embedded by iframe.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep web content open alongside notes, forcing users to switch to a browser while researching or studying.
summary: Website embedder that displays any site as a 'Gate' panel or in-note view inside the Obsidian interface.
